description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of git commands when the repository has unwritable permissions. It contains test cases for git write-tree, commit, update-index, and add operations under insufficient permission scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specific setup or conditions.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up a command to run after test completion for cleanup.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures the preceding command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test's internal clock or state.
